name: Foreground / Mid / Background Parallax Layers
principle: Compose every gameplay screen with three distinct depth layers so motion produces parallax even in 2D / 2.5D cartridges.
rules_of_thumb: Foreground: high-contrast, low-saturation silhouettes; reads as 'frame'.
Mid: full-saturation gameplay surfaces; reads as 'stage'.
Parallax speed ratio recommendation: 1.4 / 1.0 / 0.4 (FG / MID / BG).
anti_patterns: Background detail bright enough to be mistaken for gameplay surface.
All three layers at the same saturation — flattens depth perception.
